summary: A lived-in living room with a clear first session: clear the coffee table, get the cord off the floor, and tidy the obvious piles. Nothing here looks like a hidden hazard — just ordinary Saturday work.

tasks.title: Clear mugs, mail, and remotes from the coffee table
tasks.reason: The table is covered with cups, a mail stack, remotes, and a bottle — no usable surface.

tasks.title: Coil the charging cable so it is off the walkway
tasks.reason: A white cable is lying across the floor near the sofa — a simple trip risk.

tasks.title: Put the sneakers away from the wall
tasks.reason: A pair of shoes is sitting on the floor beside the sofa instead of a rack or closet.

tasks.title: Sort the laundry basket in the corner
tasks.reason: A full basket of mixed clothes is parked in the corner of the room.

tasks.title: Dust the TV stand and straighten the frames
tasks.reason: The stand looks dusty and the small frames are crowded along the shelf.

tasks.title: Wipe the coffee table once it is clear
tasks.reason: Rings and scattered items suggest the wood top needs a quick wipe.

tasks.title: Neaten the sofa pillows
tasks.reason: The throw pillows are slumped and uneven on the sofa.

tasks.title: Check the houseplant and water if the soil is dry
tasks.reason: The plant on the stand looks droopy; a photo cannot confirm soil moisture.

tasks.title: Sweep or vacuum the hardwood in the open floor
tasks.reason: The floor is mostly clear, which makes a quick pass easy before things pile up again.

cautions: The cable on the floor is a trip hazard — pick it up before you carry laundry or drinks through that path.
This sample list is a DIY starter, not a professional inspection. If something in a real room looks unsafe, stop and get qualified help.
